description: This file defines a class SineOscillator for generating sine wave signals using a Taylor series approximation, extending from a SawOscillator class. It includes methods for computing the sine of a phase and rendering the waveform.

classes.name: SineOscillator
classes.description: A sine wave oscillator that computes sine values using a Taylor series approximation, extending from SawOscillator.

methods.name: fastSin
methods.description: Calculates sine of the current phase using a Taylor expansion, with phase wrapping for approximation accuracy.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current sample of the sine wave by converting a sawtooth waveform to sine.
